name: F5
description: F5 sells application delivery and security products (load balancers, web application firewalls, API protection, multicloud networking) as hardware appliances, software and SaaS. It reports one segment. Services (support and maintenance on the installed base) are 51% of revenue, hardware systems 23% and software 26%. Two distributors each account for about 16-18% of revenue. It disclosed a long-term intrusion into its own systems in October 2025.

businessLines.name: Global services
businessLines.how: Annual and multi-year support, maintenance and professional-services contracts sold on top of products, renewed by the installed base; recurring and high margin (service gross profit about $1.34B).

businessLines.name: Systems (hardware)
businessLines.how: One-time sales of BIG-IP and related appliances through distributors and resellers; cyclical with shipment and refresh timing (-19.9% in FY2024, +31.3% in FY2025).

businessLines.name: Software (subscription, SaaS and managed services, perpetual)
businessLines.how: Term subscriptions to software versions of its products, SaaS and managed services fees, and a shrinking perpetual-licence tail.

brands.name: BIG-IP
brands.note: Flagship product family named most often in the 10-K; revenue not broken out.

brands.name: NGINX
brands.note: Open-source web server and software line named in the 10-K; revenue not broken out.

brands.name: Volterra / Distributed Cloud, CalypsoAI
brands.note: Acquired technologies named in 10-K; revenue not broken out.
